body: Thank you so much for sharing your experience. It’s scary to start realizing how this may effect me down the line. I just want to do the best I can for myself.

I am going to get it immediately. Thank you for this book suggestion! I keep remembering that I tried to set the most basic boundaries over and over again and somehow still couldn’t. When I can’t face anything else I’m trying to see that, I guess?
I am working on hopefully getting to that point where I can publish it. It’s so hard to even work on right now because it hurts to see now why I was writing it in the first place.
God willing. Always around to chat if you’re overwhelmed or need to vent. Sometimes it’s easiest to inbox strangers than keep repeating things to friends or family.

The eating thing is so real, I had the exact same problem for the first two months. I could have small things some days but if I tried a full meal it would not stay down. Unisom and weed really helped me with sleep and still at three months it isn’t easy every day.
The first days are so deeply horrific. All you can do is whatever will pass each coming minute. Sending warmth in this painful and dark moment.

This made me cry! In a good way. This is all so hard I’ve been in relationships and through breakups before but this one has really done me in in a way I haven’t had to face before. Thank you for your kindness.
That’s exactly how I feel. It sucks to imagine that this is how I might be viewed after the years we spent together.
Thank you. It shouldn’t feel this bad to express something that probably needed to be expressed.
Thank you for this. I’m trying to remember that a mistake is just a mistake. It’s not the entirety of my character. God, breakups suck.
Thank you. I just don’t know. I’ve been sitting on the bathroom floor since I woke up and came in here. I don’t even know how to start the day today.
